decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed two-storey detached house, by reason of its size, bulk, and position, would represent an unacceptable form of infill development and a cramped overdevelopment of the site, which would fail to meet the Council's Housing Standards and would provide unsatisfactory living conditions for future occupiers, by reason of enclosure of, and poor light and outlook to the rear elevation of the proposed house and the rear garden, contrary to UDP policies ENV-B.1.1, H.1.1, H.4.1 and H.6.3. of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The proposed house, by reason of its size, bulk, position forward of the building line of the cul-de-sac, and its relative position to neighbouring properties; would represent an obtrusive and unneighbourly development which would further enclose this cramped cul-de-sac, and would harm the living conditions of adjoining occupiers, by reason of loss of light and outlook, contrary to UDP policies ENV-B.1.1, H.1.1, H.4.1 and H.6.3. of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 3 - The proposed house by reason of its size, position and appearance, would represent an incongruous and unsympathetic development, out of keeping with the scale, character and pattern of development in the area, and detrimental to the appearance of the street scene, contrary to contrary to UDP policies ENV-B.1.1, H.1.1, H.4.1 and H.6.3. of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of a four bedroom detached house with associated parking & landscaping.
